{"version":"2b1","blocks":[{"type":"text","text":"The dot product of two vectors is a scalar that measures how much one vector extends in the direction of another. Geometrically, it equals the product of the lengths of the two vectors and the cosine of the angle between them."},{"type":"ui","source":"$angle = 0
$lengthA = 100
$lengthB = 80
$cosAngle = cos($angle * 3.14159 / 180)
$dotProduct = $lengthA * $lengthB * $cosAngle
$angleChoice = 0
$angleLabels = ["0° (Same direction)", "90° (Orthogonal)", "135° (Obtuse angle)"]
$angleValues = [0, 90, 135]
$angle = $angleValues[$angleChoice]
$cosAngle = cos($angle * 3.14159 / 180)
$dotProduct = $lengthA * $lengthB * $cosAngle

root = Stack([
  Text("Vector A and Vector B with angle $angleLabels[$angleChoice] between them."),
  Graphic("Vectors",
    group([
      path("M 50 120 L 50 120 H 50"),
      path("M 50 120 L 50 120"),
      path("M 50 120 L 50 120"),
      group([
        path("M 50 120 L 50 120"),
        path("M 50 120 L 50 120")
      ]),
      circle(50,120,3),
      text(50,130,"Origin")
    ])
  ),
  Text("Dot product = lengthA * lengthB * cos(angle) = $lengthA * $lengthB * cos($angle°) = $dotProduct"),
  Control("Angle between vectors",0,2,$angleChoice, $angleLabels)
])","state":[{"name":"angleChoice","value":0},{"name":"lengthA","value":100},{"name":"lengthB","value":80}]}]}

{"version":"2b1","blocks":[{"type":"text","text":"The dot product of two vectors is a scalar quantity that represents how much one vector extends in the direction of another. Geometrically, it equals the product of the magnitudes (lengths) of the two vectors and the cosine of the angle between them: dot = |A| * |B| * cos(θ)."},{"type":"ui","source":"$angleChoice = 0
$lengthA = 100
$lengthB = 80
$angleValues = [0, 90, 135]
$angleLabels = ["0° (Same direction)", "90° (Orthogonal)", "135° (Obtuse angle)"]
$angle = $angleValues[$angleChoice]
$cosAngle = cos($angle * 3.14159 / 180)
$dotProduct = $lengthA * $lengthB * $cosAngle

root = Stack([
  Text("Vector A and Vector B with angle $angleLabels[$angleChoice] between them."),
  Graphic("Vectors",
    group([
      path("M 50 120 L 150 120"),
      path("M 50 120 L " + (50 + $lengthB * cos($angle * 3.14159 / 180)) + " " + (120 - $lengthB * sin($angle * 3.14159 / 180)) ),
      circle(50,120,3),
      text(45,130,"Origin"),
      text(150,125,"A"),
      text(50 + $lengthB * cos($angle * 3.14159 / 180), 120 - $lengthB * sin($angle * 3.14159 / 180) - 5, "B")
    ])
  ),
  Text("Dot product = |A| * |B| * cos(θ) = $lengthA * $lengthB * cos($angle°) = $dotProduct"),
  Text("- When vectors are orthogonal (90°), cos(90°) = 0, so dot product is zero, indicating no projection."),
  Text("- When the angle is obtuse (e.g., 135°), cos(θ) is negative, so the dot product is negative, indicating a negative projection."),
  Control("Angle between vectors",0,2,$angleChoice, $angleLabels)
])","state":[{"name":"angleChoice","value":0},{"name":"lengthA","value":100},{"name":"lengthB","value":80}]}]}
